purpose: Freeze one exact historical-only Campaign054 minute factor, the ordered no-return admissibility gates, and the sole conditional development trial before any Campaign054 candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return is read.

prior_comparison_catalog.definition: all 76 Campaign053 comparison factors in exact reconstructed order

campaign053_terminal_no_return_audit.use: terminal no-return evidence only; no Campaign053 rescue, refit, or combination

candidate.name: intraday_volume_weighted_transaction_price_bowley_skew_240m
candidate.formula: On the exact 240-bar continuous grid, retain active bars with volume>0 and amount>0 after treating joint-zero bars as inactive and rejecting any one-sided zero. For each active bar let x_i=ln(amount_i/volume_i) and w_i=volume_i. For tau in {0.25,0.50,0.75}, Q_tau is the smallest sorted x_i whose inclusive cumulative weight is at least tau times total active weight. Return (Q_0.75+Q_0.25-2*Q_0.50)/(Q_0.75-Q_0.25).
candidate.accepted_minute_grid: 09:31--11:30 and 13:01--15:00 exactly 240 bars; source 09:30 identity row is excluded
candidate.raw_input_rule: All 240 raw volume and amount values must be finite and nonnegative.
candidate.active_bar_rule: volume>0 and amount>0; a joint-zero bar is inactive; any one-sided zero invalidates the stock-day
candidate.transaction_price_rule: x_i=natural-log(amount_i/volume_i); the positive provider-unit constant cancels from the Bowley-skew numerator and denominator
candidate.weight_rule: w_i=raw share volume and total active weight must be positive
candidate.quantile_estimator: left-continuous inverse of the share-volume-weighted empirical CDF: the smallest sorted log transaction price with inclusive cumulative weight at least tau times total active weight
candidate.tie_rule: Equal transaction prices share the same inclusive empirical-CDF location; clock order never breaks a price tie.
candidate.spread_rule: Q_0.75 must be strictly greater than Q_0.25; otherwise the factor is missing.
candidate.missing_rule: Missing unless all raw inputs obey the input and zero rules, all active ratios are finite and strictly positive, at least 120 bars are active, total active volume is positive, and Q_0.75>Q_0.25.

coverage_and_capacity_before_comparison_.coverage_basis: candidate finite rows divided by quality-and-listing eligible buyable rows within 2019-2025
coverage_and_capacity_before_comparison_.failed_gate_policy: Record the exact factor as terminal and stop before comparison values, daily prices, or forward returns.

uniqueness_after_coverage_only.method: Within each identical quality-listing-candidate-and-comparison-eligible stock-day cross-section, compute pairwise-complete Spearman correlation between directional percentile scores, then take each comparison factor's median daily correlation.
uniqueness_after_coverage_only.comparison_order_definition: Take all 76 comparison factors reconstructed by the bound Campaign053 protocol in exact order, then append terminal Campaign053 as the final item.
uniqueness_after_coverage_only.failed_gate_policy: Record the exact factor as terminal and stop before daily prices or forward returns; no rescue, reformulation, subset, combination, fit, or model.
